segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let pub = (1...3).publisher .delay(for: 1, scheduler: DispatchQueue.main) .map( { _ in return Int.random(in: 0...100) } ) .print("Random") .share() cancellable1 = pub .sink { print ("Stream 1 received: \($0)")} cancellable2 = pub .sink { print ("Stream 2 received: \($0)")} // Prints: // Random: receive value: (20) // Stream 1 received: 20 // Stream 2 received: 20 // Random: receive value: (85) // Stream 1 received: 85 // Stream 2 received: 85 // Random: receive value: (98) // Stream 1 received: 98 // Stream 2 received: 98 ```
